entries.name: Graphify
invoke_when: Direct scoped inspection cannot resolve ownership, dependencies, duplication, dead code, or broad application-code relationships.
do_not_invoke_when: The dependency chain is already clear or the claim concerns governance, CI, infrastructure, runtime state, or complete repository coverage.

entries.name: LeanCTX
invoke_when: Repeated reads or noisy output materially increase context without improving evidence.
do_not_invoke_when: Exact raw output is required or compression may hide material evidence.
entries.evidence_boundary: Compressed context is navigation, not proof.

entries.name: OpenCodeReview
invoke_when: A bounded workspace, commit, or branch-range code review is requested.
do_not_invoke_when: No review is requested or formal approval is required.
entries.evidence_boundary: Advisory findings only; no independent or formal approval.
